resources.string:
WinEntry uses Google Sign-In to identify you so the admin can set up your cloud workspace.

Signing in does NOT automatically give access to any spreadsheet. Cloud backup becomes active only after your admin creates and assigns a workspace to your account.

Until then, the app works fully offline — all data stays on your device.

Once cloud backup is active:
• Your inventory records sync to your admin-managed workspace sheet
• Admin's shared product catalogue is readable (read-only reference)

What is NEVER accessed:
• Your personal Google Drive files
• Any spreadsheets you have not been explicitly assigned
• Any other Google services

You can revoke access at any time from Google Account → Security → Third-party apps with account access.
Stock Management, Simple.\nFor Small Retail Business Use

Signing in creates your account identity only. Cloud backup requires a separate workspace — request one from your admin via Settings once you are signed in. Until then the app works fully with local data and Excel export. Your personal Drive is never accessed.
